newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain mostly lower.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash prices remained mostly weaker on Friday, capping off a week of slow farmer sales, dealers said.
But the improvement in weather in several parts of the Northern Plains has allowed trains to move grain.
"Some trains are being placed so people are moving a little bit of grain. But the farmer is not really selling much," a Minneapolis dealer said. "No new sales are coming in right now."
Another dealer agreed said the basis bids were dropping off due to slow movement.
"There is a lack of farmer selling," he said. "Trains were showing up but people did not have the wheat -- that's the rumor."
